mfa.intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.introRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each works only once.
mfa.useTotp: Use a code from the app
mfa.expired: The sign-in has expired. Enter your password again.

register.title: Registration
register.done: Done. If the e-mail has no account yet, we sent it a verification link. Please check your inbox.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

verify.title: E-mail verification
verify.invalid: The link is invalid, already used or expired. Request a new one.
verify.needed: Verify your e-mail with the link we sent you before creating a space.
verify.resent: If the account exists and is not verified, we sent it a new link.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your account's e-mail and we will send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this e-mail, we sent it a link. It is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: The password is set and every session was signed out. Please sign in again.
reset.invalid: The link is invalid, already used or expired.
